notes.text: Debit note to invoice INV-2026-0219 of May 6, 2026. It bills the two extra kiosks, the expedited freight and the installation hours added by change order PO-CR-2026-0912-A1. The original invoice remains payable in full; this note is due in addition to it.
Sales tax is collected on tangible goods and taxable services based on the ship-to address.
